clusters.name: System Decomposition Responsibility Allocation
clusters.description: How the monolith is split into microservices/modules (e.g., Customers, Orders, Delivery, Statistics) and which domains get dedicated services.

clusters.name: Request Entry Point And Routing Mechanisms
clusters.description: How client/API requests are exposed and routed (API Gateway, centralized HTTP routing, directing to appropriate services/repos).

clusters.name: Inter-Service Data Change History Strategy
clusters.description: How critical state changes are stored and replayed (e.g., event sourcing to preserve reliable event history for incidents).

clusters.name: External Payments Integration Abstraction
clusters.description: How third-party payment APIs are incorporated (adapter wrapping for consistent interfaces vs simpler internal facade exposure).

iterations.explanation: Kept existing four dimensions for decomposition, request routing, state-history strategy, and payment abstraction. New batch added orthogonal axes: client-specific backend partitioning, CRUD/data API surface, resilience/retry policy, microkernel-style algorithm modularity, internal observer-based event publication, and facade-based unified aggregation. These capture distinct architectural intent without overlapping with routing or decomposition.

clusters.description: How failed operations are retried and bounded (e.g., configurable retry limits for order placement attempts).

clusters.name: Modular Core Algorithm Plugin Architecture
clusters.description: How routing/delivery optimization algorithms are plugged into a core via pluggable modules (microkernel-style module selection).

clusters.name: Internal Event Publication And Observer Propagation
clusters.description: How microservices publish state changes to others (observer/event publication patterns for Statistics updates).

clusters.name: Facade-Based Unified Domain Aggregation
clusters.description: How a facade aggregates statistics/incidents into a single client-facing access layer rather than directly exposing multiple services.
